mapper.sql: q.id, q.type, q.subject, q.knowledge_point, q.content, q.option_a, q.option_b, q.option_c, q.option_d, q.answer, q.score, q.difficulty, q.creator_id, q.created_at, q.updated_at, u.nickname AS creator_nickname

where.if: AND (q.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR q.knowledge_point LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (type, subject, knowledge_point, content, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, answer, score, difficulty, creator_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{type}, #{subject}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{content}, #{optionA}, #{optionB}, #{optionC}, #{optionD}, #{answer}, #{score}, #{difficulty}, #{creatorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET type = #{type}, subject = #{subject}, knowledge_point = #{knowledgePoint}, content = #{content}, option_a = #{optionA}, option_b = #{optionB}, option_c = #{optionC}, option_d = #{optionD}, answer = #{answer}, score = #{score}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM question q LEFT JOIN `user` u ON q.creator_id = u.id WHERE q.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM question q LEFT JOIN `user` u ON q.creator_id = u.id
ORDER BY q.${safeSortBy} ${safeSortDir}, q.id DESC LIMIT #{safePageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT q.subject FROM question q ORDER BY q.subject ASC
